A Chinese leaker with a notable track record of leaks has recently posted multiple images purportedly showing the internal circuit diagrams of the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro.

The diagrams suggest that the new A20 Pro chip's GPU may feature seven cores, one more than the previous generation, and the memory interface is also expected to be faster…

What Weibo user "Fried White Rice" posted is not the A20 Pro chip itself, but rather diagrams showing where the chip is soldered onto the underlying circuit board. Based on these images, they have speculated on the new chip's performance and architecture, and summarised two main possible improvements.

Firstly, the circuit diagrams show that the CPU still has six cores, with the same configuration as last year: two high-performance cores and four efficiency cores. However, the cache memory on the efficiency cores appears to have increased.

Since the soldering diagrams provide limited information, it is difficult to determine the GPU core count from them — six, seven, or eight are all possible. They ultimately concluded that seven cores is the most likely.

Fixed Focus Digital previously stated that the A20 Pro chip would be 18% faster than the previous generation, with a 30% improvement in power efficiency.

9to5Mac's take

Although this Weibo account does have a certain degree of credibility, this kind of indirect speculation requires considerable expertise. While their conclusions may sound reasonable, readers should treat them as informed speculation rather than confirmed facts.
